caption: The video showcases two gloved hands holding jewelry over a red velvet surface, with a pave-set ring at the lower right throughout, its white paper tag appearing later. The left hand grips a dangling piece whose trillion-cut clear stone sits in a halo of small stones, suspended from circular pave-set links, while the right hand holds a matching stone piece. As the clip proceeds, the left hand rotates and gradually lifts the dangling piece, bringing more of the chain of circular links above the triangular stone into view. The triangular stone swings and tilts, its facets catching shifting sparkles and reflections. The right hand's stone piece drifts upward toward the frame's top edge, and the overall framing shifts a little between early and late moments. The ring on the velvet stays largely in place as the hands reposition.
